# OMP Python RPC SDK

Unmodified SDK subtree from can1357/oh-my-pi, commit
`45c35e40c46166dc726ccc52f5d27f40f2449f99` (OMP 18.12.6):
https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/tree/45c35e40c46166dc726ccc52f5d27f40f2449f99/sdk/python/omp-rpc

`omp-rpc-manifest.json` records SHA-256 of every downloaded file. The SDK license
is retained in `omp-rpc/LICENSE`. No OMP engine, binary or local patches vendored.
Install explicitly with `python -m pip install -r requirements-luna.txt`.
Use a compatible independently installed OMP executable and existing authentication.
